_comment: Producer Brief Lite — the smallest input a SKU needs to start.
It states intent, not production. Everything the machine can derive from the source
media, the registry and the locked baselines is derived, not asked for here.
Only job_id and product.name are required; everything else may be omitted.
notes: Optional free text for the authoring agent. Anything genuinely ambiguous — an unverifiable product fact, a claim that needs a decision, a creative preference — belongs here or at the gate the run stops on, not in this file as an instruction to invent something.
